evidence.notes: A concrete local Canvas lifecycle subclass returns an empty excluded context type set, proving typed override dispatch without claiming a platform default.
Local Canvas lifecycle handlers accept the mocked RenderContext.
Canvas render exceptions expose their platform type name.
The local test harness builds a Canvas.RenderContext from application and environment maps.
The local test harness dispatches the lifecycle handler with the supplied RenderContext.

name: core-runtime-canvas-local-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org rejects construction of the Canvas lifecycle handler; retained as a Glade-local contract and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCanvasLocalEvidenceTest { private class LocalHandler extends Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler { public Set<Canvas.ContextTypeEnum> excludeContextTypes() { return new Set<Canvas.ContextTypeEnum>(); } public void onRender(Canvas.RenderContext context) {} } @isTest static void exercisesLocalCanvasLifecycle() { Map<String,String> app = new Map<String,String>(); app.put('canvasUrl', 'https://canvas.example'); app.put('developerName', 'LocalCanvas'); app.put('name', 'Local Canvas'); app.put('namespace', 'local'); app.put('version', '1'); Map<String,String> env = new Map<String,String>(); env.put('displayLocation', 'Visualforce'); env.put('locationUrl', '/apex/Host'); env.put('subLocation', 'detail'); Canvas.RenderContext ctx = Canvas.Test.mockRenderContext(app, env); Canvas.ApplicationContext application = ctx.getApplicationContext(); System.assertEquals('https://canvas.example', application.getCanvasUrl()); System.assertEquals('LocalCanvas', application.getDeveloperName()); System.assertEquals('Local Canvas', application.getName()); System.assertEquals('local', application.getNamespace()); System.assertEquals('1', application.getVersion()); application.setCanvasUrlPath('/apex/Changed'); System.assertEquals('/apex/Changed', application.getCanvasUrl()); Canvas.EnvironmentContext environment = ctx.getEnvironmentContext(); System.assertEquals('Visualforce', environment.getDisplayLocation()); System.assertEquals('/apex/Host', environment.getLocationUrl()); System.assertEquals('detail', environment.getSublocation()); environment.addEntityField('Account.Name'); environment.addEntityFields(new Set<String>{'Account.Id', 'Account.Type'}); List<String> entityFields = environment.getEntityFields(); System.assertEquals(3, entityFields.size()); System.assert(entityFields.contains('Account.Name')); System.assert(entityFields.contains('Account.Id')); System.assert(entityFields.contains('Account.Type')); environment.setParametersAsJSON('{"mode":"local"}'); System.assertEquals('{"mode":"local"}', environment.getParametersAsJSON()); Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler handler = new LocalHandler(); System.assertEquals(0, handler.excludeContextTypes().size()); handler.onRender(ctx); Canvas.Test.testCanvasLifecycle(handler, ctx); Canvas.CanvasRenderException ex = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException('render failed'); System.assertEquals('Canvas.CanvasRenderException', ex.getTypeName()); } }
